morning.shape: practical and tactical. Something the reader can act on before lunch.

evening.shape: opinion, analysis or story. Something the reader argues with or forwards.

markets._comment: One market per post. next_brief.py rotates by weight and will not run the same market three times in a row. Weights are relative, not percentages: US 3 / India 2 / Estonia 1 works out to roughly 50/33/17.

US.why: Largest share of readers by a distance, and the queue had nothing aimed at them.

India.why: Home market and the deepest well of real first hand experience.

Estonia.why: Deliberate bet on a small high value export market, not a reflection of current traffic.
